theme: An open day in Toronto before tomorrow's travel.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. You're in Toronto with the ICGN meetings behind you and nothing on the calendar today — the day is yours before tomorrow's early call and evening flight to Boston.

needsAttention.title: Early call, then wheels up to Boston
